Purpose of the project

At present, there is a global trend emerging where cars utilize AI for autonomous driving instead of relying on humans.
The purpose of this project is to create learning data for autonomous driving AI.
The assignment requires working with 6 types of objects:
For “Double” solid line, label it separately
Stop-line is the Horizontal line that comes before a pedestrian crossing or traffic light.
This project is a sub-category, and each lane must be labeled with a color as shown below
“U-turn” allowing line is considered as “White, Dotted Line”
Typically, the outermost line of the road is often a solid yellow lane.
Even when lanes are blocked by obstacles (fences, cars, etc.), please consider which lane it was originally and label it accordingly.

It is very uncommon for there to be other classes of lanes on the road. Specifically, with regards to “road leader” and “bus parking lines”. Please refrain from labeling them, as they are not meant to be labeled, despite resembling lanes with different colors.
Please be careful not to label these subjects:
Discard Standard: Tasks in the following cases should be discarded.
When there is no labeling target
When there’s excessive smearing or light spillage, only one or two dim lanes remain.
When the screen image is flipped
When the pixels of the screen image are too broken or faint, only one or two dim lanes remain.

If parking lots are on the road, label the vertical line only.
Exclude labeling bus parking lots, parking lots for shops, apartments, or malls.
